name: Steel Acoustic Guitar — AG08 S5 Continuous Performance
strengths: retains AG08-S4 passive sympathetic coupling and all accepted AG01-AG07 note/action renderers
keeps arpeggio, render-local strum contacts, string muting/percussion and later fingerstyle inside one persistent six-string/bridge/body state
lets muted_strum, dead_strum and string_slap damp already-ringing physical strings at deterministic per-string contact times instead of acting only as added percussion audio
extends same-string residual carry for slide/hammer-on/pull-off while shortening residual carry for palm/fretting/dead-note contact, without creating hidden musical events
limitations: AG08-S5 remains a compact reduced-order performance-state model rather than geometry/material-derived FEM/BEM simulation
string-contact damping coefficients are bounded project-authored generic values, not measured hand/string impedance data
formal long-horizon passive energy/stability closure remains AG08-S6 and final human listening closure remains AG08-S7
